image_description: A close-up portrait of a Roseate Spoonbill (Platalea ajaja) standing in profile. The bird features distinctive pink plumage on its body and wings, with a patch of pale yellow/cream feathers on the upper back/nape. It has a long, greyish-black neck covered in fine downy feathers, leading to a prominent, elongated, spatulate bill that is grey at the base and pale/whitish at the tip. The eye is red with a dark pupil. The legs are partially visible at the bottom, appearing dark. The background is a soft, out-of-focus dark green/grey.
